subject: PO setup & invoicing for HealthGrid — multi-pay / prebilling request
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@healthgrid.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: PO setup & invoicing for HealthGrid — multi-pay / prebilling request

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the demo last week — HealthGrid is excited to move forward. A few procurement constraints to flag so we can align on billing and PO ingestion:

- They will issue a single PO that contains multiple line items for different product SKUs (in our case: Hosted API, Dedicated capacity reserve, and Support). The PO needs to be mapped to three invoice lines.
- Preferred invoice cadence: monthly. However, finance has requested a one-time prebilling equal to the first two months as a deposit (they call it a "ramp prepayment"). This should be invoiced up front and applied as a credit against months 1–2.
- Net terms: standard is Net30, but HealthGrid will ask for Net45 on this account. They require evidence of accepted delivery (SOW signed) to release the first payment.
- PO format: must include PO number, remit-to address, and entity code; they use an ERP field called "BU_CODE" for ledger routing.
- Vendor requirements: W-9 and vendor banking ACH details on file (they'll only release PO once vendor onboarding is complete).

I'm attaching the procurement's PO template (PO_template_HealthGrid.pdf) and their short billing checklist. Can you confirm if Redwood can:
  1) accept a single PO with multiple invoice line mappings,
  2) issue a prebilling invoice/credit arrangement as described, and
  3) support Net45 on an exception with finance approval?

Elena
Procurement Lead — HealthGrid
Elena Torres
elena.torres@healthgrid.com
+1 415-555-0199

---
Attachment: PO_template_HealthGrid.pdf (1 page, PDF)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO setup & invoicing for HealthGrid — multi-pay / prebilling request

Elena — thanks for the clear summary and the template. Short answers up front: yes on multi-line PO mapping, yes we can issue a prebilling invoice + credit note, and we can request a Net45 exception from Finance (not guaranteed but commonly approved for enterprise deals with SOW).

Proposed implementation plan:
1) We will ingest the PO and map the PO number to three invoice lines (Hosted API / Dedicated reserve / Support). Please include the BU_CODE field in the PO so our ERP maps it correctly.
2) Prebilling flow: Redwood will issue an upfront invoice for the agreed prepayment amount and then issue a credit note that applies to the first two monthly invoices (i.e., month 1 and month 2 will show the prepayment credit). If HealthGrid prefers a single invoice with a negative line to show the credit, we can do that instead — let me know which format works for your AP team.
3) Net terms: I'll route an exception request to Finance with the PO and signed SOW. Finance will require vendor onboarding docs (W-9 / ACH) and the signed SOW before finalizing Net45.

Action items for you please:
- Share the signed PO (scan or PDF) with PO number and BU_CODE populated.
- Confirm whether the AP team wants a separate credit note or a negative line on the invoice.
- If you want, send the DocuSign link for the SOW and we'll coordinate execution — Finance prefers the SOW to be signed prior to first invoice.

I'm attaching our internal vendor billing checklist to help speed things up.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0123

---
Attachment: vendor_billing_instructions.pdf (2 pages, PDF)

Finance team — looping you in on HealthGrid (deal HG-2027-041). Procurement has sent a signed PO (attached) and an AP net terms exception request for Net45. Key asks and required actions:

- PO: PO_HealthGrid_20270425.pdf (BU_CODE: HG-BU-3) — needs to be loaded into ERP and mapped to three invoice lines.
- Prebilling: Customer requires a one-time prepayment equal to 2 months; they want a separate credit note applied to months 1–2 (explicit audit trail). We need confirmation from Finance on whether we can accept prepayment and the mechanics for credit application.
- Net terms: Customer submitted netterms_request_HG.xlsx for Net45. Please review; finance approval required before we issue the first invoice.
- Vendor onboarding: they will provide W-9 and ACH; do we need any additional vendor docs?

Attachments included: PO_HealthGrid_20270425.pdf, netterms_request_HG.xlsx.

Can someone from finance confirm next steps and estimated SLA for exception? This is time-sensitive — customer expects first invoice within 10 business days after SOW signature.

Thanks,
